correctness.rationale: Full pinned RESULT.md checked. For each n support points, normality/Urysohn produce n disjoint continuous norm-one bumps supported in positive-measure neighborhoods. Their span is ell-infinity^n and J_mu is isometric on it. Rank-nullity forces error >=1 for every rank<n approximant; zero operator gives <=1. For finite m-point support the target has dimension m; for zero measure J=0. This holds even for nonmetrizable K and atomic or non-atomic mu.

originality.rationale: A previously published general exact approximation-number profile for weighted composition C(K)->C(L) gives a_n=eta_n for all n. Taking L=F=supp(mu), phi:F->K the inclusion, u=1 gives the identical 0/1 support-cardinality profile for restriction C(K)->C(F). Although approximation-number equality under arbitrary isometric embedding C(F)->L-infinity(mu) cannot be assumed blindly, for THIS case the earlier lower witnesses remain isometric under that embedding and the trivial rank-0/finite-rank upper bound transfers. The submitted result is therefore a routine already-dominated specialization with elementary target change; the claim of a new endpoint profile fails the novelty bar.

value.rationale: Support size is a natural invariant, but here the exact 0/1 sequence is the mechanically forced unit-weight restriction case of an already-published all-s-number profile and follows by routine disjoint-bump/rank-nullity exercises. No new motivated structural content or unknown exact fact survives beyond restating that elementary case. Accuracy and reproducibility alone cannot make this scientifically valuable as a separate claim.

final_claim: For canonical J_mu:C(K)->L-infinity(mu), a_n=1 exactly for n<=cardinality of supp(mu), otherwise 0; nonzero infinite support gives essential norm 1.
limitations: No assertion for arbitrary operators or finite L^p.
The science fails originality/value, not correctness or source integrity.
